flow: read the site's own IndexedDB + sidebar DOM (VERIFIED live 2026-09-23)

steps.note: Anonymous chat — no session snapshot needed. A fresh anonymous context shows 0 chats (the site creates the store on its FIRST chat); sendProbe drives one real probe chat (site's own JS) when a non-empty read is wanted.

Stores: saved-chats, pre-canonical-chats, chat-images, sync-credentials, sync-state. Rows keyed by chatId {title, model, messages[], reasoningMode, lastEdit, pinned, fileRefs}. Read via page.evaluate (the site's own storage). The internal '__metadata__' sentinel row is filtered out.
DOM corroboration: input[aria-label='Search chats'] + one button[aria-label='Delete Chat'] per chat row; row titles match the IndexedDB chat titles.

output.chats: Array<{id, title, model, reasoningMode, pinned, messageCount, lastEdit}>

rpc: Anonymous chats are device-local IndexedDB (namespaced to the duck.ai origin). DDG-account sync would additionally use /duckchat/v1/auth/authorize -> /auth/token -> internal_duckchat_user cookie (encrypted); not required for the anonymous read.
stealth: reads the browser's own storage — no request leaves the page. sendProbe drives a real chat through the site's own composer, indistinguishable from the user typing.
